Estimates were calculated for the current year using DISTANCE. In most cases at least the last 5 years of data were used in analysis to generate a detection profile for each species. Several conservancies have been grouped due to the low numbers of animals recorded. The bottom row of the table (hyphenated) numbers = 95% Confidence Intervals. In Sikunga, very few sightings have ever been recorded (55 for all species since 2011) and no sensible estimates for any species can be derived for this area. No estimates are given for Zebra and Buffalo as DISTANCE is not an appropriate method for these species when the number of sightings is low. These animals are usually found in large herds and numbers sighted at least provide some guide to abundance.
